admission.justification: New reviewer obligation from MIK-R86@v1 (packet a78d9ae3, Architect qualification 2026-10-08 11:18:45 UTC); implemented on the W03 successor tree 95f61633, whole-primary CODE PASS verdict 3663bf07. Evidence: l86-browser/browser-results.json: one line rows

applicability: Every row of the reviewer's navigation tree, including family, invariant, location and group rows.
conditions: A row shows its name cut with an ellipsis and one reason; a family may also carry kept. Family/member accessible names retain the title and change facts; location names retain path, range, role and reason.
Invariant titles are identifier + 120-char summary; hyphenated titles render hyphens as spaces.

The family and invariant row buttons use the whole title for their tooltip. A family row's accessible name contains its title, change badge, kept marker when present and supplied standing. An invariant row can also name eligible recorded effects.

Supplied candidate state adds a standing tag in the trailing cell. Its tooltip and the row's accessible name include the writer's role and model when available. Baseline-only rows and retired records have no candidate state tag.
exclusions: Complete guarantee or statement text, authored rationales and recorded reasons belong in the reading column. The row keeps one sort-dependent reason.
statement: Each family and invariant row stays one text line, with an ellipsis and a whole-title tooltip.
